messages:
emma-support: Heads up — several Dedicated customers reporting 429s + large tail latencies in us-east-1 for ~20m. Ticket INC-9845. Posting repro notes and logs here.

john-sre-oncall: Seeing placement/service errors spike: 'placement_denied' + 'no free slots' across the pool. 480 placement failures in last 15m.

raj-ops: Metrics: dedicated-pool-us-east1-gpu-util=95%, pending_queue=330, avg_wait=2.4m. Autoscaler tried scale +8 but only 2 nodes registered (node-init failures).

katie-eng-runtime: Pull logs from kube-provisioner show image pull errors (docker rate limit 429) and repeated backoff. Some nodes stayed in Pending for >6m.

emma-support: Customer reports they also saw 503s then a billing alert about cross-region fallback. Can billing confirm if failover caused extra charges?

mike-billing: I see a billing delta for tenant 'acme-inc' with fallback traffic routed to na-west2 reserved capacity. Marking for review — will hold adjustments until support triage completes.

john-sre-oncall: Quick repro I ran: submit 150 concurrent allocate requests against a small dedicated pool -> placement_service returns:

```
placement_response: {
  code: "PLACEMENT_DENIED",
  reason: "REGION_CAPACITY_SHORTFALL",
  suggested_action: "ROUTE_TO_FALLBACK"
}
```

raj-ops: Correlation: we had a scheduled night job (external tenant) hogging GPUs in us-east-ca zone from 02:00-04:30. Autoscaler min_size=0 for some AZs so when demand spiked the controller scaled slowly.

katie-eng-runtime: Immediate mitigation plan: enable cross-region spillover for impacted Dedicated contracts (allow_spillover=true) + bump autoscaler min to 2 for critical us-east pools. Rolling config now.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: runtime-config/us-east1/allow_spillover = true by katie-eng-runtime @ 2026-03-17T14:22Z

emma-support: Support confirmed customers reconnected post-spillover; latency improved but tail to na-west2 is higher (~120-200ms extra). Customers informed.

mike-billing: Finance will hold auto billing and prepare credits for any overage incurred due to failover routing. I'll open an adjust-request and tag affected accounts.

john-sre-oncall: Follow-ups: (1) investigate image registry rate-limit with infra (2) set autoscaler floor=2 for critical pools (3) add alert for placement_denied >50/min and for sustained pending_queue >200. I'll file tickets.

sara-eng-oncall: Noted noisy-tenant behavior — two tenants consumed ~70% of the pool during the incident window. Adding fairness caps and TPU/GPU tenancy caps to placement scoring.

emma-support: Thanks all — looping in account management to notify impacted customers and keeping incident open until postmortem. @here :loudspeaker:

sara-eng-oncall: Drafting postmortem, ETA EOD. Will include timeline, root cause (image pull limits + regional exhaustion + autoscaler config), mitigations, and customer credit proposal.
